protocol: Declarations read by eye from the original photographs and written down before any extraction run was scored. One annotator, unblinded. Two packages is far too small for an accuracy claim; this set exists to characterise one specific layout failure -- a label column joined to its value column by printed arrows, with the inkjet value block out of vertical register with the pre-printed labels.

packages.note: Nakoda Foods Ratlami Sev 400 g. The value column is printed roughly one row above the labels it belongs to, so following an arrow from a label lands on the next field's value. MRP 135 over 400 g gives 0.3375/g, which the pack prints as 0.34 per g -- the label's own arithmetic identifies which number is the net quantity.
